title: Bump claude-agent-sdk to current PyPI latest (compatible-release), verify no-override default model unchanged
summary: Move the `claude-agent-sdk` pin from `~=0.1.69` to `~=<LATEST>` — where `<LATEST>` is resolved from PyPI at bump time (do NOT hardcode a number in this ticket) — keeping the `~=` compatible-release operator. Refresh `uv.lock` via `uv lock && uv sync --all-groups`. Re-verify (against the resolved SDK's source at the pinned tag) the ProcessError constructor shape, the ClaudeAgentOptions fields the adapters use, and whether `RateLimitEvent`/`StreamEvent` are re-exported at the package top level; rewrite the pin's rationale comment to record what was actually observed AND to acknowledge that this bump reverses the prior comment's `<0.2.0` cap policy. If (and only if) the two symbols are re-exported at top level at the resolved version, flatten the `claude_agent_sdk.types` import in `src/kodezart/adapters/_sdk_mapping.py`; otherwise leave it. The load-bearing deliverable is probing the *bundled* CLI (via public paths only, no SDK-private symbols, no undocumented string-key dict reads) before and after the bump — on synced venvs on both sides — to prove the no-override default model did not silently change; if it did, the PR body must headline the change and mandate a `KODEZART_MODEL` deployment-config pin to the pre-bump value. Do not commit any PR-body file; use `gh pr create --body-file <tmp>`. `uv sync --all-groups && make check` must exit zero.
context:
Reviewer of the prior draft flagged a falsified security narrative (the tree already resolves `mcp==1.26.0` at `uv.lock:1583-`, so GHSA-9h52-p55h-vw2f is not a live motive), a lint-blocking alphabetical error in the flatten instruction, a hardcoded `~=0.2.110` target contradicting the ticket's own "confirm on PyPI" directive, a prescriptive comment template contradicting the "reflect what was actually checked" directive, a probe leaning on SDK-private symbols (`_find_cli`) and undocumented `SystemMessage.data["model"]` string-key reads, a miscited live-skip mechanism (the actual mechanism is `tests/conftest.py:30-41`, not `pyproject.toml:82` which only registers the marker string), and a `PULL_REQUEST_DESCRIPTION` file committed at repo root with no consumer or convention. This revision drops all of it and reframes the pin-comment rewrite, the flatten, and the probe as *verification tasks* driven by observation at the resolved version — not by facts baked into the ticket.

Repo state re-verified from source:
- `pyproject.toml:15-19` — current pin `claude-agent-sdk~=0.1.69` with 4-line rationale comment. Prior comment's explicit policy: "a 0.2.x release is allowed to reshuffle that surface, so cap the upper bound". This bump reverses that policy; the new comment must acknowledge and justify the reversal by listing the consumed surfaces re-verified against the resolved version.
- `uv.lock:1583-` — `mcp` already resolves to `1.26.0`. No CVE remediation follows from this bump; the CVE narrative from the prior draft is deleted.
- `src/kodezart/adapters/claude_client_executor.py:5-13, 56-65, 74-98` — SDK imports, `ClaudeAgentOptions(cwd, permission_mode, allowed_tools, resume, output_format, model)`, and the `ProcessError` handler that reads `exc.exit_code` (int|None) and `exc.stderr` (str|None), redacts before slicing to `STDERR_TAIL_BYTES`, and re-raises as `AgentSDKError`. This handler is the concrete consumer the rationale comment documents.
- `src/kodezart/adapters/claude_agent_executor.py:5-11, 50-56, 69-80` — second executor with the same SDK surface; explicit no-touch, including the TODO on symmetric `stderr_tail` propagation at lines 57-64.
- `src/kodezart/adapters/_sdk_mapping.py:3-17` — SDK imports. Line 17 is `from claude_agent_sdk.types import RateLimitEvent, StreamEvent`; per the SDK CHANGELOG these have been re-exported at the package top level since 0.1.49 (older than the current 0.1.69 pin), so the flatten is an optional cleanup enabled by the check the deliverable already requires — not a migration forced by the 0.2.x jump. Lines 46-128 hold 14 `isinstance` sites; symbols are identical objects on either import path and must not be touched.
- `src/kodezart/core/config.py:91-94` — `model: str | None = Field(default=None, description="Claude model override. None uses SDK default.")`. `main.py:55` threads that as `ClaudeClientExecutor(model=config.model)`. When unset, the bundled CLI shipped inside the SDK wheel resolves the model — this is why the bundled-CLI swap needs an explicit probe.
- `tests/adapters/test_claude_executors.py:9, 83, 109, 146, 180` — constructs `ProcessError("boom", exit_code=137, stderr=...)` and asserts round-trip through `AgentSDKError.exit_code` / `.stderr_tail`. This test is the typed enforcement contract for the ProcessError shape the rationale comment claims to document; its green state on the post-bump venv IS the pass criterion.
- `tests/conftest.py:30-41` — the `pytest_collection_modifyitems` hook that skips `@pytest.mark.live` items when `-m live` is not passed. `pyproject.toml:82`'s `markers` line only registers the marker string to silence `PytestUnknownMarkWarning`.
- `Makefile:29` — `check: verify-no-origin-literal lint type-check test`. No `uv sync` prereq in the recipe; the acceptance criterion for step 5 explicitly requires `uv sync --all-groups && make check` so a stale venv cannot silently exercise the pre-bump SDK.
- `.github/` contains only `workflows/`; no `PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` convention exists. Any PR body content is transient and must be passed via `gh pr create --body-file <tmp>`, not committed as a repo file.
- `src/kodezart/agents/__init__.py` — docstring-only reference; no active import; untouched by this ticket.

Documentation to re-consult at implementation time (starting anchors — do NOT bake specific numbers into the pin):
- PyPI JSON for the SDK: https://pypi.org/pypi/claude-agent-sdk/json — the authoritative source of "current latest". Implementer resolves `<LATEST>` here (e.g. via `uv pip index versions claude-agent-sdk`) rather than trusting any number in this ticket.
- SDK repo `__init__.py` at the pinned tag: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-agent-sdk-python — confirms whether `RateLimitEvent` and `StreamEvent` are in `__all__` at `<LATEST>` (drives the conditional flatten).
- SDK repo `_errors.py` at the pinned tag — confirms `ProcessError`'s constructor and attribute types at `<LATEST>`; the rationale comment must record what is observed there, not what this ticket asserts.
- SDK CHANGELOG — notes that the top-level re-exports for `RateLimitEvent`/`StreamEvent` have existed since 0.1.49; consequently the flatten is style cleanup, not a required migration.
- Claude Code model-config docs: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config — documents the model-resolution precedence order (session `/model` > `--model` flag > `ANTHROPIC_MODEL` env > settings file > account-tier default). The docs describe an account-tier default;they do NOT support the earlier draft's "no baseline default baked into the CLI" phrasing, which is dropped.
- PEP 440 compatible-release: https://packaging.python.org/en/latest/specifications/version-specifiers/#compatible-release — confirms `~=0.2.X` == `>=0.2.X, <0.3.0`; the correct semantics for preserving the operator discipline across the minor bump.
- `uv` sync/lock docs: https://docs.astral.sh/uv/concepts/projects/sync/, https://docs.astral.sh/uv/reference/cli/#uv-lock — the sanctioned lockfile-refresh flow (`uv lock` + `uv sync --all-groups`); no hand-edits.

Claims the implementer must NOT act on without first-party confirmation at the resolved SDK version (each was speculation in the prior draft):
- That `SystemMessage.data` carries a `"model"` string key. Its type on the SDK is `dict[str, Any]`; string-keyed access is untyped, undocumented, and version-drifting.
- That `ClaudeSDKClient(...).query("")` (empty-string prompt) emits a system-init frame without billing.
- That `SubprocessCLITransport._find_cli()` is stable. It is a private symbol.

The probe in deliverable 2 is therefore designed to touch only public surfaces: locate the bundled CLI via the public `claude_agent_sdk.__file__` package attribute (`pathlib.Path(claude_agent_sdk.__file__).parent / "_bundled" / "claude"`), read that binary's own `--version` and `--help`, and use whatever documented flag *that CLI version* exposes for reading the resolved default. No SDK-private modules, no undocumented dict-key reads.

requiredChanges.description: (a) Resolve the current PyPI latest for `claude-agent-sdk` at execution time (e.g. `uv pip index versions claude-agent-sdk` or `curl -s https://pypi.org/pypi/claude-agent-sdk/json | jq -r .info.version`). Call it `<LATEST>`. (b) On line 19, replace `claude-agent-sdk~=0.1.69` with `claude-agent-sdk~=<LATEST>`. Keep the `~=` compatible-release operator; do NOT switch to a bare `>=`. Do not touch any other dependency line. (c) Read the SDK source at the pinned `<LATEST>` tag on https://github.com/anthropics/claude-agent-sdk-python and re-verify: the `ProcessError(message, exit_code, stderr)` constructor signature and attribute types (`_errors.py`); whether `RateLimitEvent` and `StreamEvent` are in `claude_agent_sdk.__all__` (`__init__.py`); whether `ClaudeAgentOptions` still exposes `cwd, permission_mode, allowed_tools, resume, output_format, model` unchanged. (d) Rewrite the 4-line rationale comment on lines 15–18 to record ONLY what was observed at `<LATEST>` and to explicitly acknowledge that this bump reverses the prior comment's `<0.2.0` cap policy — the prior policy was defensive against a hypothesized 0.2.x reshuffle; the reversal is admissible only because the listed surfaces have been re-verified intact. No prescriptive text is provided here; content dictates length. Do NOT include any `mcp` / CVE / GHSA claim in the comment — `uv.lock` already resolves `mcp==1.26.0`, so there is no remediation motive.
requiredChanges.rationale: The pin is the single source of truth for the SDK dependency; the rationale comment is documentation the maintainers will trust in future incidents. Baking a hardcoded version into the ticket or a prescriptive comment template contradicts the task's own "confirm the current latest on PyPI first" and "reflect what was actually checked" directives — both are verification tasks whose outputs are unknown at ticket-write time. The comment must also acknowledge the policy reversal so a future reader knows the `<0.2.0` cap was consciously removed, not accidentally widened.

requiredChanges.description: Refresh via tooling only: run `uv lock` at the repo root, then `uv sync --all-groups`. Do NOT hand-edit. Confirm the `[[package]] name = "claude-agent-sdk"` block resolves to `<LATEST>`. Do not add or restate any `mcp`-related claim — the pre-bump tree already resolves `mcp==1.26.0` (`uv.lock:1583-`), so no `mcp` action or commentary is admissible in this ticket.
requiredChanges.rationale: Machine-generated lockfiles must be regenerated by their tool of record; hand edits risk producing a lock uv cannot verify. The explicit `uv sync --all-groups` step ensures the venv reflects the new lock — without it, subsequent measurements (deliverable 2) and `make check` (deliverable 3) would silently exercise the pre-bump SDK.

requiredChanges.description: Conditional flatten. At implementation time, inspect `claude_agent_sdk.__all__` (or the SDK's `__init__.py` at the `<LATEST>` tag). IF `RateLimitEvent` and `StreamEvent` are both re-exported at the package top level, then: delete line 17 (`from claude_agent_sdk.types import RateLimitEvent, StreamEvent`) and merge those two symbols into the existing `from claude_agent_sdk import (...)` block on lines 3–16. Do NOT prescribe an insertion position — `ruff` I001 enforces import sorting and `make check` will surface any mistake; the linter is the source of truth. IF either symbol is NOT re-exported at `<LATEST>`, leave the file untouched. Do not touch the 14 `isinstance` sites on lines 46–128; the symbols are identical objects on either import path. Per the SDK CHANGELOG the re-exports have existed since 0.1.49, so this cleanup is optional YAGNI-scoped churn; if it feels marginal at review time, leaving the `.types` submodule import in place is acceptable.
requiredChanges.rationale: The task explicitly requires the check; the change is admissible only as its outcome. Prescribing an insertion position in prose duplicates rules already codified in `ruff`'s I ruleset — and encoding both in prose is what led to the previous draft's lint-blocking alphabetical error.

requiredChanges.description:
This is an acceptance criterion, not a file. The PR body (submitted via `gh pr create --body-file <tmp>` or pasted into the PR UI at merge time) must contain a section titled "No-override default model — before / after" satisfying ALL of the following. Do NOT commit any file at repo root (no `PULL_REQUEST_DESCRIPTION`, no `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`) as part of this ticket — no lifecycle consumes such a file and no convention exists in this repo.

Prerequisites (implementer confirms up front; if either is unavailable, the PR is not mergeable and the block is surfaced rather than papered over): (i) valid Claude credentials in the shell running the probe (`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` or an authenticated Claude Code login); (ii) network egress to Anthropic's API from that shell.

Probe method — bundled CLI via public paths only, no SDK-private symbols, no undocumented dict-key reads:
  1. Locate the bundled CLI via the public `claude_agent_sdk.__file__` attribute:
     `uv run python -c "import claude_agent_sdk, pathlib; print(pathlib.Path(claude_agent_sdk.__file__).parent / '_bundled' / 'claude')"`
  2. Run `<cli-path> --version` to anchor the bundled CLI version.
  3. Consult `<cli-path> --help` at the resolved version to identify a documented flag that reveals the resolved default model without opening a billable turn (e.g. `--print` with a JSON output format, or an equivalent handshake documented for that CLI version). Use only what the CLI's own help text documents at that version. Do not use undocumented flags; do not read `SystemMessage.data["model"]` (typed `dict[str, Any]`, no guaranteed key); do not import from `claude_agent_sdk._internal`.
  4. If credentials or network are unavailable, record that fact in the PR body, do not merge, and open a follow-up to complete the probe from an authorized shell.

Execution — venv state must be explicit on BOTH sides of the comparison:
  Pre-bump: `git checkout main && uv sync --all-groups && <probe> → capture verbatim`.
  Post-bump (after Required Changes 1, 2, and conditionally 3): `uv sync --all-groups && <probe> → capture verbatim`.

Verdict recorded in the PR body: if the two probes report the same resolved default, state so plainly (e.g. "Both bundled CLIs resolve the no-override default to `<model>`. No productionbehavior change from this bump."); if they differ, the PR body headlines that change at the top of the description (not buried in a subsection), AND mandates as a rollout condition that `KODEZART_MODEL` be pinned in deployment configuration to the pre-bump model string so runtime behavior stays unchanged until someone deliberately opts into the new default. Do not modify `src/kodezart/core/config.py`'s `None` default in this ticket — the mitigation is a deployment-config pin, not a source change.
requiredChanges.rationale: This is the load-bearing safety deliverable and the reason the ticket is not a trivial version bump. The prior draft's probe leaned on SDK-private symbols (`SubprocessCLITransport._find_cli()`), on an undocumented dict-key read (`SystemMessage.data["model"]`), and on the unverified belief that `ClaudeSDKClient.query("")` emits an init frame without billing — all speculation. The probe must be built from publicly documented CLI surfaces only. The venv-state discipline on both sides of the measurement is what prevents a stale venv from silently reporting the pre-bump CLI on both sides and rubber-stamping the deliverable. The mitigation for a changed default is a deployment-config action, not a repository file, so PR body content is transient and passed via `gh pr create --body-file <tmp>`.

requiredChanges.description: NO EDIT to `Makefile` itself. This entry exists to state the acceptance criterion: `uv sync --all-groups && make check` must exit zero on the final branch state. The explicit `uv sync --all-groups` prereq is mandatory — `check`'s recipe (`verify-no-origin-literal lint type-check test`) does not itself sync the venv, so a stale venv would silently pass the check against the pre-bump SDK. If mypy strict or ruff surfaces a real regression (most likely from the conditional flatten), fix at source; do NOT disable rules — the project's policy is never-disable-linter without explicit user approval.
requiredChanges.rationale: The prior draft's acceptance criterion omitted the sync prereq, opening the loophole where a stale venv could satisfy `make check` against the old SDK. Making the sync explicit closes that loophole. No source change to the Makefile itself is required; the `Makefile` entry is intentional documentation of the pass criterion.

outOfScope: Changing `src/kodezart/core/config.py`'s `model: str | None = None` default. Deliverable 2 exists to prove that staying `None` remains safe.
Editing `src/kodezart/adapters/claude_agent_executor.py`, including the TODO on symmetric `stderr_tail` propagation at lines 57-64.
Editing `src/kodezart/adapters/claude_client_executor.py`'s `ProcessError` handler logic; only the rationale comment in `pyproject.toml` documenting its contract may change.
Reshaping any type in `src/kodezart/types/domain/agent.py` or `src/kodezart/domain/errors.py` (in particular, adding fields to make the probe convenient).
Refactoring the `AgentExecutor` protocol, symmetrizing error handling across executors, or adding model awareness to the second executor.

Committing any file at repo root or under `.github/` for PR body content — no `PULL_REQUEST_DESCRIPTION`, no `PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`. PR body content is transient and passed via `gh pr create --body-file <tmp>`.
Adding any operator-facing model-override doc, reasoning-effort / thinking configuration, or any new `AppConfig` field.
Any live-agent run (`pytest -m live`) against a shared or production instance as part of this change.
Restarting any running service as part of this change.
Basing the branch on the last release tag — the branch must be cut from current `main` head.
Restating a CVE / GHSA / `mcp<1.23` motive in the ticket, PR, or rationale comment — `uv.lock` already resolves `mcp==1.26.0`, so no such motive is live.
